title: Trace relation proven to be a partial order at Heathrow
summary: Don Hoffman tells of Trace relation proven to be a partial order at Heathrow, about about two years before recording at Heathrow, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: so I took it to Jayton I said look Jayton I think this thing is a logic technically a partial order and he said Don it's too pretty to be true and he had to fly somewhere So he got to Heathrow and decided to check it and he proved it.

plain: A researcher named Don Hoffman, whom a podcast title calls an MIT scientist, says that about two years before the interview he suspected a piece of his mathematical theory, a link he calls the trace relation, was a partial order, a precise kind of mathematical ranking. He says he took it to a colleague, Jayton Posash, who called it too pretty to be true, then checked it while at Heathrow airport in London and proved it. Hoffman tells it because it would mean the math behind his ideas about reality holds up.
